echo.text: This data product loads deals from the CRM deals API, continuing through every page (including after a token refresh or rate-limit retry) and lands a 'deals' model with exactly deal_id, stage, amount, and updated_at; the source status value is consulted only in memory to decide which rows are current and is never landed anywhere. It answers two questions: what deals are currently active with their stage, amount, and last-updated time, and the count and total amount of active deals broken down by stage. Scope: only current (non-deleted) deals are included; owner name and owner email are dropped at ingestion and never land in any stored or served surface, including any raw/internal relation; no priority or attention ranking is computed, since none was requested. The term 'Current deal' defines current as the source status field reporting active rather than deleted, and uses the platform-default P3 priority since no priority was stated in the document. The term 'Redacted field' defines a field dropped entirely from every landed and served relation, and also uses the platform-default P3 priority since no priority was stated. The transform filters in memory before any row lands, then lands only deal_id, stage, amount, and updated_at -- status is never a landed column. The 'Current deals' output promises that every row is a current deal, that owner name and email never appear in this output or any other stored surface, and that no ranking or attention-score field is ever produced. Three decisions are recorded: the current-deal definition rests on the source status field and that value is never landed anywhere; owner and email are redacted at ingestion; and no attention ranking is computed because no threshold was supplied.

contracts.guarantee: Every output row is a current (non-deleted) deal.
contracts.rule: Exclude rows whose status marks the deal as deleted.

contracts.guarantee: No output row, and no other stored surface of this product, includes owner name or owner email.
contracts.rule: Never land or serve the owner name or owner email fields.

contracts.guarantee: No row or field in this output represents a priority or attention ranking.
contracts.rule: Do not compute or include a ranking or attention-score field.

decisions.ruling: Use the source status field to distinguish current (active) deals from deleted deals; current means the source reports the deal as active, not deleted. The status value itself is never landed in any stored surface of this product, including the deals relation: it is read and consulted only in memory during ingestion, so a consumer with direct access to the landed data sees no status column anywhere.
Owner name and owner email are dropped at ingestion and never land in any stored surface of this product, raw or served.
This product does not compute, land, or expose a priority or attention ranking of deals, because no ranking threshold was supplied.

proposal.intent: Provide a governed, queryable view of the current CRM sales pipeline for sales-ops and revenue-analyst review. The product exposes active deal records (identifier, stage, amount, last-updated time) while keeping account-owner identity details out of every stored and served surface.

promises.guarantee: Every output row is a current (non-deleted) deal.
promises.rule: Exclude rows whose status marks the deal as deleted.

promises.guarantee: No output row, and no other stored surface of this product, includes owner name or owner email.
promises.rule: Never land or serve the owner name or owner email fields.

promises.guarantee: No row or field in this output represents a priority or attention ranking.
promises.rule: Do not compute or include a ranking or attention-score field.

questions.question: What deals are currently active in the CRM pipeline, and what stage, amount, and last-updated time does each have?
What is the count and total amount of active deals, broken down by stage?

proposal.scope: Include only current deals from the CRM deals source: records whose source status field marks them active rather than deleted. Exclude deleted deals entirely from every relation this product lands or serves. Retrieve every deal across every page the source reports, continuing after a token refresh or a rate-limit retry rather than stopping early. Exclude owner name and owner email from every stored and served surface, including any raw/internal landed relation, not only the final output; these fields are dropped at ingestion rather than masked. Do not compute, land, or expose a priority/attention ranking or score for deals, because no ranking threshold was supplied.

terms.definition: A deal whose source status field indicates it is active rather than deleted, evaluated against the value the source reports for that record. "Current" here is a status classification, not a time-window calculation, so it needs no clock anchor.
terms.name: Current deal

terms.definition: A field that is removed from all landed and served relations of this product, rather than masked, truncated, or replaced with placeholder text. Owner name and owner email are the redacted fields for this product.
terms.name: Redacted field
